# HUNTR (huntr.id)
> Your One-Stop Procurement Partner. A cloud-based B2B procurement platform in Indonesia connecting buyers looking to purchase goods and services with qualified vendors.

## Overview
HUNTR (https://huntr.id) simplifies enterprise and business procurement by centralizing supplier discovery, request for quotations (RFQs), open tender management, vendor management, e-catalogues, contract tracking, spend analytics, and secure B2B payments (HUNTR Pay).

## Core Capabilities
- **Supplier Discovery**: Discover verified vendors and suppliers matching business requirements across Indonesia.
- **Requests & Quotations (RFQ)**: Create, publish, compare, and manage RFQs and vendor proposals in one transparent workflow.
- **Open Tenders**: Real-time marketplace of public and private RFQs allowing vendors to bid and submit quotations.
- **Marketplace & E-Catalogue**: Browse pre-vetted products, office equipment, industrial spare parts, warehouse consumables, and logistics services.
- **Vendor Management**: Onboard, evaluate, and coordinate with suppliers in a structured portal.
- **Contract Management**: Track agreements, procurement terms, milestones, and deliverables.
- **Purchasing & Fulfilment**: Coordinate purchase orders (PO), delivery schedules, and receipts.
- **HUNTR Pay**: Secure B2B payment escrow and settlement solutions tailored for corporate transactions.
- **Spend & Reporting**: Real-time visibility into company procurement spend and vendor performance.
- **Agentic & Digital Procurement**: AI-assisted supplier matching and proposal evaluation to empower human decision-makers.

- **Enterprise Growth**: Rp 48.947.368 / year (35 users, 4 companies, 2 warehouses, 3,000 e-Faktur/year, 2,000 AI/month, Budget Procurement Plan, Priority support)
- **Enterprise Pro**: Rp 75.000.000 / year (200 users, 10 companies, 100 warehouses, 5,000 e-Faktur/year, 10,000 AI/month, CRM Enterprise, Budget Procurement Plan, Priority support)
